steps.body: Three numbers make one fact family: 3, 4, and 12 give two multiplications and two divisions.
steps.narration: Three numbers make one fact family: 3, 4, and 12 give two multiplications and two divisions.

widget.prompt: Build an array with 6 rows of 7.
widget.factorFeedback: That rectangle covers 42 squares, but not as 6 rows of 7. Build the arrangement the fact describes.
widget.lowFeedback: That is fewer than 42 squares. Keep building until the array is complete.
widget.highFeedback: That is more than 42 squares. The array should stop at 6 rows of 7.

predict.prompt: 6 × 7 = 42. How many other facts does that give you free?

options.label: Three — one more product and two quotients

predict.reveal: The family holds 6×7=42, 7×6=42, 42÷6=7 and 42÷7=6 — four facts from one relationship.
